exports.name: Semantic manifest
exports.description: Inspect Semantic's packaged export IDs. Invoke only tools present in the enabled tool catalog; this manifest does not enable other plugins.

exports.name: Get semantic tree
exports.description: Discover project containment with explicit project_root, then retain this project's semantic_element_id values. Agent workflow: locate the owner, inspect get_dependency_tree/trace_path and get_git_impact, read current source and check_index_coverage before editing. Verify changes with focused tests and refresh through the supported compiled project indexer; never fabricate ingest batches. This tree shows indexed structure, not proof that current source is fresh.

exports.name: Get dependency tree
exports.description: Inspect indexed dependencies, dependents, or both for an existing semantic_element_id from the current project. This ID-only request has no project_root field: verify returned project_root. Include descendants when assessing module impact; missing or cyclic branches require investigation, not assumptions of complete call resolution.

exports.name: Get semantic element at location
exports.description: Resolve a 1-based source line to indexed semantic owners using explicit project_root and path. Inspect candidates before choosing the narrowest anchor; indexed line ranges may lag current source.

exports.name: Search semantic elements
exports.description: Find indexed owners by semantic or lexical search with explicit project_root. Inspect mode/index_state and use returned IDs for focused tree, dependency, or source reads; an empty or stale index does not prove the code is absent.

exports.name: Rebuild semantic search index
exports.description: Rebuild search vectors for existing indexed elements in explicit project_root. Inspect the returned index_state; this does not parse changed source or rebuild static relationships. Refresh stale source through the compiled project indexer first.

exports.name: Ingest semantic index batch
exports.description: Persist genuine source-indexer output for explicit project_root/provider_instance_id. Use the supported compiled project indexer with compiler-derived evidence where available; never fabricate semantic IDs, ranges, fingerprints, or relationships from an agent summary. replace_paths/removed_paths replace indexed partitions; snapshot pages require consistent job/page metadata. Keep workflow tasks and human notes out of source-index batches.

exports.name: Record semantic index log
exports.description: Record an indexer's actual progress/error evidence with explicit project_root and provider_instance_id. A recorded status is bookkeeping, not a source refresh or proof of completed ingestion.

exports.name: Get latest semantic index log
exports.description: Read latest indexing progress for explicit project_root and, when known, provider_instance_id. Check status, errors and completion evidence before relying on indexed results; timestamps alone do not establish source freshness.

exports.name: List semantic graph providers
exports.description: List indexed project roots. Choose the exact projectRoot for the current checkout before project-scoped queries; display names and content fingerprints are not project identity.

exports.name: Project semantic graph
exports.description: Project indexed nodes/edges for explicit projectRoot, targetPath and granularity. Use includeFirstNeighbors/includeExternal when inspecting nearby impact; this renderer projection is not a complete source or compiler call graph.

exports.name: Create semantic PZ snapshot
exports.description: Start a semantic PZ snapshot for explicit project_root. Track its operation_id with semantic_snapshot_status; acceptance alone is not successful snapshot completion. This exports existing semantic state, not a source reindex.

exports.name: Get semantic PZ snapshot status
exports.description: Inspect the operation_id returned by snapshot creation for progress, completion or failure. Restore the originating project context before using the result; this ID-only request does not take project_root.

exports.name: Cancel semantic PZ snapshot
exports.description: Request cancellation of a known snapshot operation_id. Check status afterward; cancellation is not evidence of a completed usable snapshot.

exports.name: Count project elements
exports.description: Count indexed elements for explicit project_root. Use counts to diagnose missing coverage, not to infer that current checkout files were fully parsed.

exports.name: Get full-fidelity semantic context
exports.description: Read full-fidelity elements, relationships or artifacts from one indexed project snapshot with explicit project_root. Select record_kind and optionally root_element_id/include_descendants; inspect commit_version/published_at rather than treating indexed records as current source.

exports.name: Semantic context over HTTP
exports.description: HTTP envelope adapter for semantic_context. Put explicit project_root and record_kind in the JSON body; interpret snapshot revision and root scope as on the MCP read.

exports.name: Search context over HTTP
exports.description: HTTP envelope adapter for semantic element search. Put explicit project_root/query in the JSON body and inspect search mode/index_state.

exports.name: Semantic relationship tree over HTTP
exports.description: HTTP envelope adapter for dependency-tree reads. Supply a semantic_element_id discovered in the current project in the JSON body and verify returned project_root.

exports.name: Semantic element upserted
exports.description: Runtime-delivered element-change trigger maintains search vectors for actual indexed records. Agents should refresh via the compiled indexer, not synthesize storage-trigger deliveries.

exports.name: Semantic artifact upserted
exports.description: Runtime-delivered artifact-change trigger maintains search vectors for existing indexed artifacts. It is not an agent task/checkpoint write interface.

exports.name: search graph
exports.description: Ranked symbol search with regex name/path filters and stable offset pagination. Use explicit project_root. Start with this project's indexed symbols, then inspect tree/dependencies, trace_path and get_code_snippet before editing. For pagination retain commit_version as expected_commit_version and restart if it changes.

expected_commit_version.description: Reject stale pagination when the static index changes.

exports.name: get code snippet
exports.description: Read current source for an indexed element; reports index/source fingerprint agreement. Use explicit project_root. Inspect index_matches_source: false or unknown means indexed ranges/fingerprints do not establish current-source agreement. Refresh with the compiled project indexer before trusting stale ownership or impact.

expected_commit_version.description: Reject stale pagination when the static index changes.

exports.name: search code
exports.description: Ranked text or regex search of indexed files with innermost symbol context. Use explicit project_root. Reads current worktree text within indexed paths; owner ranges remain indexed. Inspect failures/failure_count and source_revision, and restart paginated reads if expected_commit_version is rejected.

expected_commit_version.description: Reject stale pagination when the static index changes.

exports.name: get graph schema
exports.description: Summarize observed element kinds, edge labels and public fields. Use explicit project_root. Choose relationship_labels from observed kinds/labels before tracing impact. Static resolution is syntax-derived; runtime-origin edges are observations, not compiler proof.

expected_commit_version.description: Reject stale pagination when the static index changes.

exports.name: trace path
exports.description: Trace calls with direction, depth and edge-label filters; unknown receivers are excluded. Use explicit project_root. Use inbound for callers/impact, outbound for dependencies, or both. Empty relationship_labels includes all non-containment relationships; missing edges/unknown receivers are not proof of no callers.

expected_commit_version.description: Reject stale pagination when the static index changes.

relationship_labels.description: Empty array includes all non-containment relationships.

exports.name: get git impact
exports.description: Read git changes against a base commit and find transitive callers at file granularity. Use explicit project_root. Set the intended base (default HEAD), inspect unindexed_paths and transitive inbound impact, then read current source and run affected tests. File-level impact is conservative and limited by index coverage.

expected_commit_version.description: Reject stale pagination when the static index changes.

relationship_labels.description: Empty array includes all non-containment relationships.

exports.name: get graph metrics
exports.description: Report fan-in/out hotspots, cyclic components and heuristic dead-code candidates. Use explicit project_root. Treat dead-code candidates as hypotheses: entrypoints, callbacks, macros and unresolved references may be live. Confirm with source, compiler diagnostics and tests before deletion.

expected_commit_version.description: Reject stale pagination when the static index changes.

relationship_labels.description: Empty array includes all non-containment relationships.

exports.name: check index coverage
exports.description: Report per-file parser coverage, syntax recovery and resolution outcomes; old indexes require reindexing. Use explicit project_root. Inspect parser status, syntax recovery and unresolved/ambiguous references before trusting impact. Unknown metadata needs reindexing through the compiled project indexer; unresolved external/receiver references are not dead-code proof.

expected_commit_version.description: Reject stale pagination when the static index changes.

exports.name: ingest runtime trace
exports.description: Replace one named runtime trace of observed calls between indexed IDs; preserve static extraction. Use explicit project_root. Submit only measured calls between active IDs in this project, with positive counts and a trace_id. Reusing trace_id replaces its observation set; it does not repair or replace the static source index.

expected_commit_version.description: Reject stale pagination when the static index changes.
